steps.clueRiddle:
Out the back door to wilder lands.
Level Two needs sharper eyes and dirtier hands.
steps.clueReveal: Head out to the backyard. This is Explorer Training: Level Two. Find all six things on the list.

challenges.title: Explorer Training: Level Two
challenges.instructions: Last summer's training was the easy version. Find all six things. Look low, look high, look under.
checklist: A stick shaped like the letter Y
The softest thing in the yard
A rock with more than one colour
Something that was not here last week

steps.funFact: Rainy day? The same hunt works out a window or on the balcony.

steps.clueRiddle:
Stand in the middle and turn around slow.
How many windows watch you below?
steps.clueReveal: Stand in the middle of the yard. Turn in a slow circle. Count every window you can see on your house.

challenges.title: Window Watch
challenges.instructions: Turn slowly and scan your whole house. Count every window you can see. Type your number in the box.

steps.funFact: Racers call this a recce — saying it like WRECK-ee sounds cool.

steps.clueRiddle:
Who has the fastest feet in the family?
Two laps, ten jumps, one superhero.
steps.clueReveal: Who's got the fastest feet? Run the backyard obstacle circuit. Beat two minutes on the stopwatch!

challenges.title: Backyard Obstacle Grand Prix
challenges.instructions: Start the clock and do every move on the list. Go as fast as you safely can. Finish before two minutes run out!
checklist: Run two laps of the yard
Touch the fence or the farthest wall

steps.funFact: Spinning three times makes the running part much funnier to watch.

steps.clueRiddle:
Sit where you can see your training grounds.
Stamp what you spot, then test your brain.
steps.clueReveal: Sit on the porch or a step. Play Backyard Bingo with your eyes on the yard. Then take the nature quiz.

challenges.title: Backyard Bingo
challenges.instructions: Look around the yard for each square. Tap it when you spot it. Four in a row is a bingo!

challenges.title: Nature Trivia Deck
challenges.instructions: Ten questions about bugs, birds and backyards. Guess before you tap. Every answer has a fun fact.

steps.funFact: The backyard bingo card is the same one you trained on last summer.

steps.clueRiddle:
The mat is out on the grass tonight.
Run to it — the standings are tight!
steps.clueReveal: Race to the mat in the backyard. Step on it with both feet. The host has serious news tonight.
steps.funFact: Watch out — somebody always gets lost on expedition legs.
